'''Communications Bunker 22''' was a communications bunker operated by the [[InterStellar Regulators]] in the [[Sanctuary research complex]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Communications Bunker 22 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
